code_hints: If the final URL matches the locale root (e.g., /en-jp/), immediately replace it using the normalize rule to the curated PLP before waiting for product tiles.
After navigation, first attempt to click cookie and geo-continue buttons using pre_click_selectors; retry twice with small delays (300–500 ms).
Wait for any of wait_for_selectors.plp before extracting tiles; if not present after 5s, trigger a gentle scroll (viewport height) and wait again.
Implement infinite scroll using the provided config; stop early when the selector_count threshold is reached.
If PLP selectors never materialize on the first start_url, iterate fallback_start_urls in order.
Only enqueue PDP links extracted from within elements matching article[itemtype*="schema.org/Product"] or [data-testid*="product-tile"], to avoid header/footer links.
Guard against cross-domain and non-product pages using url_rules allow/block lists when following links.
rationale: ホーム（/en-jp/）には商品タイルが出ないため、PLP未出現で失敗。まず開始URLを確実なPLPへ正規化（men/ready-to-wear/down-jackets）し、Cookie同意・地域確認モーダルを先に処理。PLPではスキーマや汎用タイル名に基づく待機セレクタを用意し、無限スクロールを軽く行ってから抽出。URLルールでルート着地の罠や外部ドメイン（monclergroup等）への逸脱を抑止し、UTM等の不要パラメータも除去。セレクタ自体は現状壊れていない可能性が高いため変更は最小限とし、主因である着地点・モーダル対処・待機の堅牢化を優先。
